description: Receipts and Expenditures for Highways by Federal Agencies, 1999-2024 (FA-5) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. Annual summary of receipts and expenditures for highways by Federal Agencies, funding source, and type of income or expense at the national level from the Highway Statistics Series table FA-5. (Note: Number of rows per year varies by the number of federal agencies included in report.). Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 7 columns, among them Fund, Funding, Year, Outlays, Type, Agency. The portal shows 2026-06-08 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
